hey everyone! This morning, me and my partner went to MH for -as we thought- our first B1 joined interview but instead they told us that this meeting is just to extend my tourist visa for another 3 months until we have the interview. When I asked If i am allowed to leave and re-enter she said yes because technically I am on a normal tourist visa. Is that safe? Anyone who has done that? We were so sure to receive the B1 with the meeting today and were hoping to go to Sinai for my birthday this month:( 
Would love to know if you know more than me🫶🏼
